items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: The Judge fined us... The Judge, he was an Englishman. I forget his name.

ctx.x: I thought you said you'd been in the cell 15 minutes.
Yeah. But the Judge read off the charges and this was in the newspapers, and the courtroom was full of onlookers. They come in --
Well, how long were you in jail?
